XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Ignition coil with spark plug leads

  • Fault: The generic fault light has come on, accompanied by the engine fault light flashing and occasional drops in performance.

  • Faults detected by the on-board diagnostics:
  • P0300 (Misfire in unspecified cylinders – Generic fault)
  • P0304 (Misfire in cylinder 4 – Generic fault)
  • Cause: Faulty/compromised ignition coil with spark plug leads

• Task: Check the condition and correct operation of the ignition coil and its associated spark plug leads and, if necessary, replace them

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located centrally, beneath the air filter housing, and can be accessed once the housing has been removed.

    The estimated time required for this procedure is approximately 0.7 hours.
